claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes time and spatial distance as mental constructions dependent on consciousness and its sequence of thoughts.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says astral experience varies by each being’s consciousness and vibration; shared realms arise through compatible perceptual agreements.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes the lower astral as resembling the material world and generally inhabited by entities, egregors, and deceased beings strongly attached to it.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Higher- or lower-frequency attention is said to manifest more pleasant or unpleasant realms.
